Room.title: Room
Room.description: Multiplayer Word Battle game room state, settings, players map, clues, votes, and round outcome.

hostId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the current room host

settings.description: Host-configured category, round count, and imposter count

players.description: Map of player UIDs to player state (max 10 players)

usedPairIds.description: Word pair IDs already used in this session

roundConfig.description: Active round word pair, roles, turn order, and timer

clues.description: Optional typed clues submitted during discussion

votes.description: Map of voter UID to suspected player UID

outcome.description: Computed round winner, vote counts, and awarded points

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when room was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last room update

Signal.title: Signal
Signal.description: WebRTC peer-to-peer voice signaling message (SDP offer/answer or ICE candidate).

AnimalRoom.title: AnimalRoom
AnimalRoom.description: 2-player Guess the Animal room state, turn tracking, Q&A history, and finish outcome without exposing secret animals.

playerIds.description: Exactly 1 or 2 player UIDs permitted in this room

players.description: Map of up to 2 player profiles and pick status

revealedAnimals.description: Empty until phase is finished, when each player reveals their own secret animal

AnimalSecret.title: AnimalSecret
AnimalSecret.description: Private secret animal choice owned and readable strictly by a single player UID.

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Active Word Battle multiplayer game rooms keyed by 5-character room code.

/rooms/{roomCode}/signals/{signalId}.description: Ephemeral WebRTC voice signaling payloads targeted to a specific player UID.

/animal_rooms/{roomCode}.description: Active 2-player Guess the Animal rooms keyed by 5-character room code.

/animal_rooms/{roomCode}/secrets/{uid}.description: Player-private secret animal document readable and writable strictly by its owner UID.

/animal_rooms/{roomCode}/signals/{signal.description: Optional WebRTC voice signaling payloads between the 2 Guess the Animal players.
